restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text: The service is good and has better standards than the clinics near my house. It's also better than the dental clinic at Ramathibodi Hospital because they provide blankets, mouthwash, and X-rays. The doctor is polite and has good principles. However, there are many procedures and the price is expensive. However, it's acceptable if you're impressed.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text:
Dental services are available in two systems:
1. Teaching system
2. Service system
The teaching system is staffed by medical students and postgraduate students.
The service system is staffed by dental professors, general practitioners, and specialists.
The service is excellent, the management is superb, the doctors and assistants are very friendly, as are all the other related staff.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text: 67.09.05_ Took my mom to the dentist, it was great, very clean. The tropical science department is very mysterious. I liked that there was a night market, it was excellent. The food at the night market was delicious and varied.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text: Great, special clinic on the 2nd floor, go up the escalator and you'll see it right away. There are a lot of staff, working hard, using a microphone to announce names, examining quickly. The doctor's fee is more expensive than the normal side. It's teachers and students who have graduated and come to do it. There are specialists, you can feel at ease if you go to the dentist here because there are specialists such as gum doctors, surgeons, crown dentists. Suitable for anyone who wants to get their teeth done quickly, see a good doctor, don't have a long wait, but the doctor's fee is much more expensive, I think it's 1,400 baht just for the doctor's fee 🤑🙊 but the medicine is very cheap.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text:
The place is clean and beautiful, with excellent equipment. The dentist is gentle and very skilled.
I had my dental work done by Dr. Thanabodee and was very pleased. The assistants are also very skilled. I have experience in everything from dental implants to dental work for decades. I just found a very skilled dentist here. The price is reasonable.
The service is punctual, organized, clean, and comfortable. The design of the place is
very good. It's a convenient building, similar to the Somdej Phra Thep Building at Ramathibodi Hospital.
The Mdent dental strings from Mahidol are of better quality than the foreign ones sold in general stores.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text:
Excellent doctors, reasonable prices, and a great location. Parking is a bit limited, so you have to allow extra time for waiting. However, the quality is incredibly good. I had my procedure with Dr. Thaweephong, who is excellent and friendly. His assistants are also skilled and agile. 👍👍

At first, I was a little confused by the system, but as I've been here more, I've gotten the hang of it. When I need to come in for an emergency, I've come to understand what to do. Just be prepared for the wait, and rescheduling appointments is incredibly difficult due to the long queues. However, considering the quality and confidence in the doctors, I think it's worth it.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text: The doctor is skilled and provides good service, but he has a problem with time management. I need to come for continuous treatment often. He is often late for appointments. On average, he is 20-30 minutes late, but at most, he is 40 minutes late.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text: I went to the dentist several years ago and had a great experience. The dentist did a great job; there were no problems at all. But this time, I had two fillings done. They didn't have enough emalgam material and wouldn't add more because of time constraints. The dentist just filled them, mentioning on the bill what kind of material it was, which I don't know. They also hinted at needing root canal treatment if the teeth fell out again. I left feeling uneasy. What happened next was that one tooth caved in and the other fell out in less than a month. When I called, they said I could come in for emergency treatment, but they didn't know how long I'd have to wait. If I scheduled an appointment, I'd have to wait until next month. Waiting for the same dentist might incur additional costs, but changing dentists would be like getting the teeth redone. I've decided I won't go back. I should have believed previous reviews saying the dentist had changed. I wasted both time and money, and might lose a tooth that shouldn't have been lost. A clinic might be better; at least they wouldn't rush the process. They only had 30 minutes, and the price wasn't cheap – I paid 1800 baht, but it felt like nothing was done.

restaurant_name: MU DENT Faculty of Dentistry (Special Clinic)
text: I'm confused about the service. I asked at the finance counter if, as a returning patient, I needed to register at the medical records counter. They didn't answer, just pointed to the medical records counter. So I went to the medical records counter, and they told me to go to the second floor. On the second floor, I filled out a form for patients without appointments or in emergencies. When the staff checked it, they said it was only for emergencies. I'm confused, does this mean I have to call to make an appointment every time from now on? If I arrive at the hospital without an appointment, I can't do it? Will the hospital provide a form for people without appointments? I came because the doctor is good, and some of the staff are nice, but the service was very disappointing.
